design.question: Does cross spectroscopy distinguish interaction and independent source/readout directions after complex calibration is profiled?
design.gain_model: independent complex affine source/readout per field; charge is calibrated
design.noise: One common absolute circular-complex RMS sigma=epsilon*A over all entries, frequencies, both fields and both truth directions. A is the clean transferred RMS over all four complete truth datasets. E|noise|^2=sigma^2.
design.profile_cases: both truths, independent source model, full observations, Bplus and joint; symmetric diagonal Bplus control
design.mesh_comparison: identical higher observation, clean transfer functions and common absolute sigma; refit known, shared and independent directions on lower templates
design.reporting: Report every result, failed optimizer and boundary hit. Local normalized Jacobian singular values are after projecting affine gain nuisance columns. Neither local rank nor multistart/profile results prove global identifiability or statistical coverage. No material vertex is claimed.
